description: Pokémon Red / Blue / Yellow (Gen-1, GB / GBC). 8-button controller, simpler menu structure than Gen-3.

confirm.hint: Advance dialog one box. Talk to NPC. Pick up item. Confirm a menu choice. Same conceptual role as in any Pokémon game.

cancel.hint: Cancel / back out / close menu. (No running in Gen-1 -- the running shoes don't exist yet.)

menu.hint: Open the main menu: Pokédex, Pokémon, Item, Save, Option, Exit. (Player profile is in the Trainer Card sub-menu.) Only available in the overworld.

nav_up.hint: Walk one tile north. First press while facing another direction just turns you to face north.

nav_down.hint: Walk one tile south. First press just turns you to face south.

nav_left.hint: Walk one tile west. First press just turns you to face west.

nav_right.hint: Walk one tile east. First press just turns you to face east.

notes: Select is largely unused in Gen-1 (a few sub-menus accept it). Exposed as passthrough so it's available without competing with a universal verb.
